assembly_notes: Lift-and-pull convertible sofa bed. One rigid sofa_frame root carries the carcass, the fixed arms, the REAR seat band and the carriage guides. back_panel_count back_panel parts are REVOLUTE (+x) children of the frame. The pullout_carriage is a PRISMATIC (+y) child of the frame; the deck_lift_stage is a PRISMATIC (+z) child of the carriage; the bed_deck is FIXED on that lift stage. The seat is cushioned only over its REAR band and the deck's retracted footprint lies entirely forward of it, so raising the deck while the carriage is still in never drives it into the seat -- deck up + carriage in is the sofa, deck up + carriage out is the bed, and deck down is the stowed platform. Every single-joint boundary pose is therefore clear. Four component slots vary without touching the mechanism: back_build, deck_build, lift_frame and carriage_style. width_m, seat_depth_m and bed_height_m are independent continuous parameters deriving panel pitch, deck length, carriage travel, lift travel and hinge heights; palette and tufting counts are non-core. The arm build is its own slot: the fixed surround is one full-height upholstered block, while the fold-down arm shortens that block to a base and hinges the upper panel on its outer top edge so the panel rolls outward and up into a bed extension instead of sweeping down through the base.
